Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 39397 of 2024

Applicant :- Rahul
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Dushyant Singh,M.C. Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed by the applicant is taken on record.
2.  Sri Rajeev Dhar Dwivedi, learned AGA for the State apprised the Court that on 13.09.2024 notice has been served to the informant of the case.
Despite service of notice, none appeared on behalf of the informant.

3. Heard Sri Dushyant Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Rajeev Dhar Dwivedi,
learned AGA for the State-respondent.
4.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
102 of 2024, under Sections 376, 506 IPC & 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station- Pahasu, District- Bulandshahr, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

5. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and according to FIR, applicant committed rape upon the daughter of the informant aged about 17 years 8 months under the pretext to provide Rahul vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125523959/
1 some treatment through religious procedure.

entities.text: Rahul vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that on the basis of false allegation, applicant has been made accused in the present matter and actually applicant provided treatment on the basis of religious procedure and in this regard, he received Rs. 2,500 from the informant for the purpose of treatment of his daughter i.e. victim as she suffered with stomach pain but she could not be benefited and thereafter informant demanded back his money and when applicant refused to return the same then he lodged the FIR of the present case.

7. He further submitted that victim is about 18 years old and even from her statement recorded before the trial court, which has been annexed along with the supplementary affidavit filed in support of the instant bail application, it reflects that she was a married girl and however, she made allegation of rape against the applicant but story narrated by her does not appear to be convincing and on her version no reliance can be placed.
8.

He further submitted that applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter,
he is in jail since 22.04.2024 i.e. for last almost eight months.
9.

Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that victim is aged about 17 years 8 months and she in her both the statements recorded during investigation made allegation of rape against the applicant and therefore, considering the nature of allegation levelled against the applicant, he should not be released on bail.
10. I have heard both the parties and perused the record of the case.
11.

However, in the FIR as well as in both the statements of the victim recorded during investigation,
there is allegation of rape against the applicant but victim appears to be about 18 years old married girl and story narrated by her does not appear to be convincing and considering her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., the defence taken by learned counsel for the applicant in the instant bail application, cannot be completely ruled out at this stage.
12. Further, applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter, he is in jail since 22.04.2024 i.e. for last almost 8 months.
13. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
14. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

15. Let the applicant- Rahul be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-

sentences.text: (i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
16. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

17. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
